heading: Tuesday, December 5, 2023
topLine: Lean formalization of the Polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa proof completed in three weeks.

items.headline: Lean formalization of the Polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa proof completed in three weeks
items.summary: A collaborative Lean 4 project led by Terence Tao, with Yaël Dillies and many contributors, finished formalizing the recent proof of Marton's Polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa conjecture (the m=2 case) about three weeks after it began. The Lean kernel checks the full proof from the standard axioms. The work was done by humans; it is often cited as an early test of fast, large-team formalization.
